info.name: 📌 Perplexity AI API
info.description:
### About

"Perplexity is a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question."

Perplexity's Sonar models answer with live web search results and citations, and its Search API returns ranked web results. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Search & retrieval**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- Perplexity AI Account: [https://www.perplexity.ai/](https://www.perplexity.ai/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `perplexity_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:perplexity_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/chat-completions-post](https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/chat-completions-post)
    
- Models: [https://docs.perplexity.ai/getting-started/models](https://docs.perplexity.ai/getting-started/models)
